paths.descriptionEn: Build every component of a Transformer from scratch — activations, normalization, attention, and the full GPT-2 block.
paths.descriptionZh: 从零构建 Transformer 的每个组件——激活函数、归一化、注意力机制到完整的 GPT-2 Block。

paths.descriptionEn: Master every attention variant and position encoding technique — from scaled dot-product to Flash Attention, RoPE, and ALiBi.
paths.descriptionZh: 掌握所有注意力变体和位置编码技术——从缩放点积到 Flash Attention、RoPE 和 ALiBi。

paths.descriptionEn: Build and train a complete GPT — from embeddings and transformer blocks to Adam, cosine LR, and mixed precision.
paths.descriptionZh: 构建并训练完整的 GPT——从 Embedding 和 Transformer Block 到 Adam、余弦学习率和混合精度。

paths.descriptionEn: Speed up inference with KV cache, quantization, and decoding strategies. Scale training with tensor parallelism, FSDP, and ring attention.
paths.descriptionZh: 通过 KV Cache、量化和解码策略加速推理。用张量并行、FSDP 和环形注意力扩展训练规模。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement the loss functions and search algorithms behind modern AI alignment — from reward modeling to PPO and MCTS.
paths.descriptionZh: 实现现代 AI 对齐背后的损失函数和搜索算法——从奖励建模到 PPO 和 MCTS。

paths.descriptionEn: Build a ViT from the ground up — convolutions, patch embeddings, attention, and the full ViT block.
paths.descriptionZh: 从零构建 ViT——卷积、Patch Embedding、注意力机制到完整的 ViT Block。

paths.descriptionEn: From noise schedules to flow matching — implement the core algorithms behind Stable Diffusion 3, Flux, and DiT.
paths.descriptionZh: 从噪声调度到流匹配——实现 Stable Diffusion 3、Flux 和 DiT 背后的核心算法。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement the cutting-edge attention and routing mechanisms powering DeepSeek, Meta, and Microsoft's latest models.
paths.descriptionZh: 实现驱动 DeepSeek、Meta 和微软最新模型的前沿注意力与路由机制。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement QK normalization, hybrid local/global masking, and a configurable GQA attention block; connect each tradeoff to pinned Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Mistral, Kimi, and GLM sources.
paths.descriptionZh: Implement QK normalization, hybrid local/global masking, and a configurable GQA attention block; connect each tradeoff to pinned Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Mistral, Kimi, and GLM sources.

paths.descriptionEn: Implement token-choice routing, capacity-aware sparse dispatch, and a complete TinyMoE training step; connect utilization and stability tradeoffs to pinned DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, and Qwen code.
paths.descriptionZh: Implement token-choice routing, capacity-aware sparse dispatch, and a complete TinyMoE training step; connect utilization and stability tradeoffs to pinned DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, and Qwen code.

paths.descriptionEn: Build REINFORCE, GRPO, and DAPO foundations, then complete agentic and asynchronous rollouts. Audit RL data, perplexity, confidence, embedding diversity, and gradient orthogonality before implementing KD, sampled-token OPD, and privileged-context OPSD.
paths.descriptionZh: 从 REINFORCE、GRPO、DAPO 到 agentic 异步 rollout；再练习数据审计、困惑度、置信度、两种正交性，以及 KD、OPD 和 OPSD 蒸馏。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement a validated tool API, a budgeted retrying agent loop, and resumable supervisor-worker orchestration with deterministic failure injection, backpressure, idempotency, checkpoints, and pinned OpenClaw, Hermes, and Microsoft Agent Framework code connections.
paths.descriptionZh: Implement a validated tool API, a budgeted retrying agent loop, and resumable supervisor-worker orchestration with deterministic failure injection, backpressure, idempotency, checkpoints, and pinned OpenClaw, Hermes, and Microsoft Agent Framework code connections.

paths.descriptionEn: Implement deterministic policy composition, capability-bound human approval, and a provenance-aware guarded runtime with injection defense, redaction-before-audit, delegation limits, and cancellation.
paths.descriptionZh: Implement deterministic policy composition, capability-bound human approval, and a provenance-aware guarded runtime with injection defense, redaction-before-audit, delegation limits, and cancellation.

paths.descriptionEn: Master GNN fundamentals — from basic graph convolution to attention, message passing, and graph-level tasks.
paths.descriptionZh: 掌握图神经网络基础——从图卷积到注意力、消息传递和图级任务。

paths.descriptionEn: Classic machine-learning interview staples: losses, regularization, optimizers and evaluation metrics, each implemented and explained from first principles.
paths.descriptionZh: Classic machine-learning interview staples: losses, regularization, optimizers and evaluation metrics, each implemented and explained from first principles.

paths.descriptionEn: Where the time and memory go in LLM training and serving, and the standard fixes: precision, recomputation, packing, fused losses, sharding and parallelism for training; KV caching, paging, quantization and speculative decoding for inference.
paths.descriptionZh: Where the time and memory go in LLM training and serving, and the standard fixes: precision, recomputation, packing, fused losses, sharding and parallelism for training; KV caching, paging, quantization and speculative decoding for inference.

paths.descriptionEn: Mechanisms from DeepSeek's plugin-first agent harness: an event bus with five dispatch modes, the guarded tool pipeline and cooperative timeouts, advisory loop guards, crash recovery and replay of an append-only session log, tool-output pruning, and cache-aware system prompt updates.
paths.descriptionZh: Mechanisms from DeepSeek's plugin-first agent harness: an event bus with five dispatch modes, the guarded tool pipeline and cooperative timeouts, advisory loop guards, crash recovery and replay of an append-only session log, tool-output pruning, and cache-aware system prompt updates.

paths.descriptionEn: Mechanisms from the Pi coding agent: the agent loop with steering and follow-ups, parallel tool batches, streaming tool arguments, cross-provider transcript handoff, the fuzzy multi-edit tool, per-file mutation queues, output truncation and compaction cut points.
paths.descriptionZh: Mechanisms from the Pi coding agent: the agent loop with steering and follow-ups, parallel tool batches, streaming tool arguments, cross-provider transcript handoff, the fuzzy multi-edit tool, per-file mutation queues, output truncation and compaction cut points.

paths.descriptionEn: Streaming LLMs end to end. Token streams: SSE decoding, delta accumulation, streamed tool calls, incremental detokenization, stop strings and backpressure. Endless generation: attention sinks, sink-cache re-rotation and H2O eviction. Real-time interaction: full-duplex micro-turn sessions (Thinking Machines), embodied action streams (SIMA 2) and posed-frame context for world models (RTFM).
paths.descriptionZh: Streaming LLMs end to end. Token streams: SSE decoding, delta accumulation, streamed tool calls, incremental detokenization, stop strings and backpressure. Endless generation: attention sinks, sink-cache re-rotation and H2O eviction. Real-time interaction: full-duplex micro-turn sessions (Thinking Machines), embodied action streams (SIMA 2) and posed-frame context for world models (RTFM).

paths.descriptionEn: Adapt a frozen model by training a tiny fraction of its parameters. LoRA and its merge path for zero-latency serving, DoRA's magnitude and direction split, QLoRA on a quantized base, and prefix tuning's trainable per-layer key/value prefix.
paths.descriptionZh: Adapt a frozen model by training a tiny fraction of its parameters. LoRA and its merge path for zero-latency serving, DoRA's magnitude and direction split, QLoRA on a quantized base, and prefix tuning's trainable per-layer key/value prefix.
